<?php
// Test fixtures for post-content-to-markdown.

// A post the post_allowed filter excludes from Markdown.
add_filter('post_content_to_markdown/post_allowed', function ($allowed, $post) {
    return $post->post_name === 'hidden-post' ? false : $allowed;
}, 10, 2);

// Content that only logged-in users may see.
add_shortcode('members_only', function ($atts, $content = '') {
    return is_user_logged_in() ? $content : '[login required]';
});

// A shortcode exposing data commenters must not be able to invoke.
add_shortcode('private_data', function () {
    return 'PRIVATE-DATA-1e7a';
});

add_action('init', function () {
    register_block_type('fixtures/private-data', [
        'render_callback' => function () {
            return 'PRIVATE-BLOCK-DATA-6d0b';
        },
    ]);
});

add_filter('post_content_to_markdown/feed_include_comments', '__return_true');

// Let tests start from an empty Markdown feed cache.
add_action('init', function () {
    if (isset($_GET['clear_markdown_feed_cache'])) {
        \PostContentToMarkdown\clearFeedCache();
    }
});
